Na vedanā na khandho, na khandhā na viññāṇaṃ.

Feeling is not an aggregate, and aggregates are not consciousness.

Na [M 0.0051] saññā na khandho, na khandhā na rūpaṃ.

Perception is not an aggregate, and aggregates are not form.

Na saññā na khandho, na khandhā na vedanā.

Perception is not an aggregate, and aggregates are not feeling.

Na saññā na khandho, na khandhā na saṅkhārā.

Perception is not an aggregate, and aggregates are not formations.

Na saññā na khandho, na khandhā na viññāṇaṃ.

Perception is not an aggregate, and aggregates are not consciousness.

Na saṅkhārā na khandho, na khandhā na rūpaṃ.

Formations are not an aggregate, and aggregates are not form.

Na saṅkhārā na khandho, na khandhā na vedanā.

Formations are not an aggregate, and aggregates are not feeling.

Na saṅkhārā na khandho, na khandhā na saññā.

Formations are not an aggregate, and aggregates are not perception.

Na saṅkhārā na khandho, na khandhā na viññāṇaṃ.

Formations are not an aggregate, and aggregates are not consciousness.

Na viññāṇaṃ na khandho, na khandhā na rūpaṃ.

Consciousness is not an aggregate, and aggregates are not form.

Na viññāṇaṃ na khandho, na khandhā na vedanā.

Consciousness is not an aggregate, and aggregates are not feeling.

Na viññāṇaṃ na khandho, na khandhā na saññā.

Consciousness is not an aggregate, and aggregates are not perception.

Na viññāṇaṃ na khandho, na khandhā na saṅkhārā.

Consciousness is not an aggregate, and aggregates are not formations.

Khandhayamakamātikā niṭṭhitā.

The Matrix of the Pairs on the Aggregates is finished.

Āyatanayamakaṃ

The Pairs on the Sense Bases

Paṇṇattivāro

The Section on Designations

Dvādasāyatanāni [V 0.0048] (yama. 1.āyatanayamaka.1 ādayo) – cakkhāyatanaṃ sotāyatanaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ jivhāyatanaṃ kāyāyatanaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ saddāyatanaṃ gandhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ manāyatanaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ.

The twelve sense bases: the eye-base, the ear-base, the nose-base, the tongue-base, the body-base, the form-base, the sound-base, the odor-base, the taste-base, the tangible-base, the mind-base, the mental-object-base.

Padasodhanavāro

The Section on the Analysis of Terms

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Cakkhu cakkhāyatanaṃ, cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhu.

The eye is the eye-base; the eye-base is the eye.

Sotaṃ sotāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ sotaṃ.

The ear is the ear-base; the ear-base is the ear.

Ghānaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ ghānaṃ.

The nose is the nose-base; the nose-base is the nose.

Jivhā [M 0.0052] jivhāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ jivhā.

The tongue is the tongue-base; the tongue-base is the tongue.

Kāyo kāyāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ kāyo.

The body is the body-base; the body-base is the body.

Rūpaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ, rūpāyatanaṃ rūpaṃ.

Form is the form-base; the form-base is form.

Saddo saddāyatanaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ saddo.

Sound is the sound-base; the sound-base is sound.

Gandho gandhāyatanaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ gandho.

Odor is the odor-base; the odor-base is odor.

Raso rasāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ raso.

Taste is the taste-base; the taste-base is taste.

Phoṭṭhabbo phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbo.

The tangible is the tangible-base; the tangible-base is the tangible.

Mano manāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ mano.

The mind is the mind-base; the mind-base is the mind.

Dhammo dhammāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ dhammo.

A mental object is the mental-object-base; the mental-object-base is a mental object.

Paccanīkaṃ

Negative

Na [V 0.0049] cakkhu na cakkhāyatanaṃ, na cakkhāyatanaṃ na cakkhu.

Not the eye, not the eye-base; not the eye-base, not the eye.

Na sotaṃ na sotāyatanaṃ, na sotāyatanaṃ na sotaṃ.

Not the ear, not the ear-base; not the ear-base, not the ear.

Na ghānaṃ na ghānāyatanaṃ, na ghānāyatanaṃ na ghānaṃ.

Not the nose, not the nose-base; not the nose-base, not the nose.

Na jivhā na jivhāyatanaṃ, na jivhāyatanaṃ na jivhā.

Not the tongue, not the tongue-base; not the tongue-base, not the tongue.

Na kāyo na kāyāyatanaṃ, na kāyāyatanaṃ na kāyo.

Not the body, not the body-base; not the body-base, not the body.

Na rūpaṃ na rūpāyatanaṃ, na rūpāyatanaṃ na rūpaṃ.

Not form, not the form-base; not the form-base, not form.

Na saddo na saddāyatanaṃ, na saddāyatanaṃ na saddo.

Not sound, not the sound-base; not the sound-base, not sound.

Na gandho na gandhāyatanaṃ, na gandhāyatanaṃ na gandho.

Not odor, not the odor-base; not the odor-base, not odor.

Na raso na rasāyatanaṃ, na rasāyatanaṃ na raso.

Not taste, not the taste-base; not the taste-base, not taste.

Na phoṭṭhabbo na phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, na phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ na phoṭṭhabbo.

Not the tangible, not the tangible-base; not the tangible-base, not the tangible.

Na mano na manāyatanaṃ, na manāyatanaṃ na mano.

Not the mind, not the mind-base; not the mind-base, not the mind.

Na dhammo na dhammāyatanaṃ, na dhammāyatanaṃ na dhammo.

Not a mental object, not the mental-object-base; not the mental-object-base, not a mental object.

Padasodhanamūlacakkavāro

The Section on the Analysis of Terms with the Root Wheel

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Cakkhu [M 0.0053] cakkhāyatanaṃ, āyatanā sotāyatanaṃ.

The eye is the eye-base; the ear-base is a base.

Cakkhu cakkhāyatanaṃ, āyatanā ghānāyatanaṃ.

The eye is the eye-base; the nose-base is a base.

Cakkhu cakkhāyatanaṃ, āyatanā jivhāyatanaṃ…pe….

The eye is the eye-base; the tongue-base is a base… and so on….

Cakkhu cakkhāyatanaṃ, āyatanā dhammāyatanaṃ.

The eye is the eye-base; the mental-object-base is a base.

Sotaṃ sotāyatanaṃ, āyatanā cakkhāyatanaṃ.

The ear is the ear-base; the eye-base is a base.

Sotaṃ sotāyatanaṃ, āyatanā ghānāyatanaṃ…pe….

The ear is the ear-base; the nose-base is a base… and so on….

Sotaṃ sotāyatanaṃ, āyatanā dhammāyatanaṃ.

The ear is the ear-base; the mental-object-base is a base.

Ghānaṃ [V 0.0050] ghānāyatanaṃ, āyatanā cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe….

The nose is the nose-base; the eye-base is a base… and so on….

Ghānaṃ ghānāyatanaṃ, āyatanā dhammāyatanaṃ…pe….

The nose is the nose-base; the mental-object-base is a base… and so on….

Dhammo dhammāyatanaṃ, āyatanā cakkhāyatanaṃ.

A mental object is the mental-object-base; the eye-base is a base.

Dhammo dhammāyatanaṃ, āyatanā sotāyatanaṃ…pe….

A mental object is the mental-object-base; the ear-base is a base… and so on….

Dhammo dhammāyatanaṃ, āyatanā manāyatanaṃ. (Cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ.)

A mental object is the mental-object-base; the mind-base is a base. (The wheel is to be constructed.)

Paccanīkaṃ

Negative

Na cakkhu na cakkhāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na sotāyatanaṃ.

Not the eye, not the eye-base; not a base, not the ear-base.

Na cakkhu na cakkhāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na ghānāyatanaṃ…pe….

Not the eye, not the eye-base; not a base, not the nose-base… and so on….

Na cakkhu na cakkhāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na dhammāyatanaṃ.

Not the eye, not the eye-base; not a base, not the mental-object-base.

Na sotaṃ na sotāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe….

Not the ear, not the ear-base; not a base, not the eye-base… and so on….

Na sotaṃ na sotāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na dhammāyatanaṃ.

Not the ear, not the ear-base; not a base, not the mental-object-base.

Na ghānaṃ na ghānāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe….

Not the nose, not the nose-base; not a base, not the eye-base… and so on….

Na ghānaṃ na ghānāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na dhammāyatanaṃ…pe….

Not the nose, not the nose-base; not a base, not the mental-object-base… and so on….

Na dhammo na dhammāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na cakkhāyatanaṃ.

Not a mental object, not the mental-object-base; not a base, not the eye-base.

Na dhammo na dhammāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na sotāyatanaṃ…pe….

Not a mental object, not the mental-object-base; not a base, not the ear-base… and so on….

Na dhammo na dhammāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na manāyatanaṃ. (Cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ.)

Not a mental object, not the mental-object-base; not a base, not the mind-base. (The wheel is to be constructed.)

Suddhāyatanavāro

The Section on Mere Bases

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Cakkhu [M 0.0054][V 0.0051] āyatanaṃ, āyatanā cakkhu.

The eye is a base; bases are the eye.

Sotaṃ āyatanaṃ, āyatanā sotaṃ.

The ear is a base; bases are the ear.

Ghānaṃ āyatanaṃ, āyatanā ghānaṃ.

The nose is a base; bases are the nose.

Jivhā āyatanaṃ, āyatanā jivhā.

The tongue is a base; bases are the tongue.

Kāyo āyatanaṃ, āyatanā kāyo.

The body is a base; bases are the body.

Rūpaṃ āyatanaṃ, āyatanā rūpaṃ.

Form is a base; bases are form.

Saddo āyatanaṃ, āyatanā saddo.

Sound is a base; bases are sound.

Gandho āyatanaṃ, āyatanā gandho.

Odor is a base; bases are odor.

Raso āyatanaṃ, āyatanā raso.

Taste is a base; bases are taste.

Phoṭṭhabbo āyatanaṃ, āyatanā phoṭṭhabbo.

The tangible is a base; bases are the tangible.

Mano āyatanaṃ, āyatanā mano.

The mind is a base; bases are the mind.

Dhammo āyatanaṃ, āyatanā dhammo.

A mental object is a base; bases are a mental object.

Paccanīkaṃ

Negative

Na cakkhu nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na cakkhu.

The eye is not a base; bases are not the eye.

Na sotaṃ nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na sotaṃ.

The ear is not a base; bases are not the ear.

Na ghānaṃ nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na ghānaṃ.

The nose is not a base; bases are not the nose.

Na jivhā nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na jivhā.

The tongue is not a base; bases are not the tongue.

Na kāyo nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na kāyo.

The body is not a base; bases are not the body.

Na rūpaṃ nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na rūpaṃ.

Form is not a base; bases are not form.

Na saddo nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na saddo.

Sound is not a base; bases are not sound.

Na gandho nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na gandho.

Odor is not a base; bases are not odor.

Na raso nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na raso.

Taste is not a base; bases are not taste.

Na [V 0.0052] phoṭṭhabbo nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na phoṭṭhabbo.

The tangible is not a base; bases are not the tangible.

Na mano nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na mano.

The mind is not a base; bases are not the mind.

Na dhammo nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na dhammo.

A mental object is not a base; bases are not a mental object.

Suddhāyatanamūlacakkavāro

Section on the Root Wheel of Pure Bases

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Cakkhu [M 0.0055] āyatanaṃ, āyatanā sotaṃ…pe….

The eye is a base; the ear is a base… and so on.

Cakkhu āyatanaṃ, āyatanā dhammo.

The eye is a base; a mental object is a base.

Sotaṃ āyatanaṃ, āyatanā cakkhu…pe….

The ear is a base; the eye is a base… and so on.

Sotaṃ āyatanaṃ, āyatanā dhammo.

The ear is a base; a mental object is a base.

Ghānaṃ āyatanaṃ, āyatanā cakkhu…pe….

The nose is a base; the eye is a base… and so on.

Ghānaṃ āyatanaṃ, āyatanā dhammo…pe….

The nose is a base; a mental object is a base… and so on.

Dhammo āyatanaṃ, āyatanā cakkhu.

A mental object is a base; the eye is a base.

Dhammo āyatanaṃ, āyatanā sotaṃ…pe….

A mental object is a base; the ear is a base… and so on.

Dhammo āyatanaṃ, āyatanā mano. (Cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ.)

A mental object is a base; the mind is a base. (The wheel should be bound.)

Paccanīkaṃ

Negative

Na cakkhu nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na sotaṃ…pe….

The eye is not a base; the bases are not the ear… etc.

Na cakkhu nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na dhammo.

The eye is not a base; the bases are not phenomena.

Na sotaṃ nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na cakkhu…pe….

The ear is not a base; the bases are not the eye… etc.

Na sotaṃ nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na dhammo.

The ear is not a base; the bases are not phenomena.

Na [V 0.0053] ghānaṃ nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na cakkhu…pe….

The nose is not a base; the bases are not the eye… etc.

Na ghānaṃ nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na dhammo…pe….

The nose is not a base; the bases are not phenomena… etc.

Na dhammo nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na cakkhu.

Phenomena are not a base; the bases are not the eye.

Na dhammo nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na sotaṃ…pe….

Phenomena are not a base; the bases are not the ear… etc.

Na dhammo nāyatanaṃ, nāyatanā na mano. (Cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ.)

Phenomena are not a base; the bases are not the mind. (The wheel should be constructed.)

Āyatanayamakamātikā niṭṭhitā.

The Matrix of the Yamaka on Bases is finished.

Dhātuyamakaṃ

The Yamaka on Elements

Paṇṇattivāro

Section on Designations

Aṭṭhārasa [M 0.0056] dhātuyo (yama. 1.dhāturamaka.1 ādayo) – cakkhudhātu sotadhātu ghānadhātu jivhādhātu kāyadhātu rūpadhātu saddadhātu gandhadhātu rasadhātu phoṭṭhabbadhātu cakkhuviññāṇadhātu sotaviññāṇadhātu ghānaviññāṇadhātu jivhāviññāṇadhātu kāyaviññāṇadhātu manodhātu manoviññāṇadhātu dhammadhātu.

The eighteen elements: eye-element, ear-element, nose-element, tongue-element, body-element, form-element, sound-element, odor-element, taste-element, tangible-element, eye-consciousness-element, ear-consciousness-element, nose-consciousness-element, tongue-consciousness-element, body-consciousness-element, mind-element, mind-consciousness-element, and phenomena-element.

Padasodhanavāro

Section on the Analysis of Terms

Anulomaṃ

Positive

Cakkhu cakkhudhātu, cakkhudhātu cakkhu.

The eye is the eye-element; the eye-element is the eye.

Sotaṃ sotadhātu, sotadhātu sotaṃ…pe….

The ear is the ear-element; the ear-element is the ear… etc.

Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe….

Eye-consciousness is the eye-consciousness-element; the eye-consciousness-element is eye-consciousness… etc.

Mano manodhātu, manodhātu mano.

The mind is the mind-element; the mind-element is the mind.

Manoviññāṇaṃ [V 0.0054] manoviññāṇadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu manoviññāṇaṃ.

Mind-consciousness is the mind-consciousness-element; the mind-consciousness-element is mind-consciousness.

Dhammo dhammadhātu, dhammadhātu dhammo.

Phenomena are the phenomena-element; the phenomena-element is phenomena.

Paccanīkaṃ

Negative

Na cakkhu na cakkhudhātu, na cakkhudhātu na cakkhu.

The eye is not the eye-element; the eye-element is not the eye.

Na sotaṃ na sotadhātu, na sotadhātu na sotaṃ…pe….

The ear is not the ear-element; the ear-element is not the ear… etc.

Na cakkhuviññāṇaṃ na cakkhuviññāṇadhātu, na cakkhuviññāṇadhātu na cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe….

Eye-consciousness is not the eye-consciousness-element; the eye-consciousness-element is not eye-consciousness… etc.

Na mano na manodhātu, na manodhātu na mano.

The mind is not the mind-element; the mind-element is not the mind.

Na [M 0.0057] manoviññāṇaṃ na manoviññāṇadhātu, na manoviññāṇadhātu na manoviññāṇaṃ.

Mind-consciousness is not the mind-consciousness-element; the mind-consciousness-element is not mind-consciousness.

Na dhammo na dhammadhātu, na dhammadhātu na dhammo.

Phenomena are not the phenomena-element; the phenomena-element is not phenomena.

Padasodhanamūlacakkavāro

Section on the Root-Wheel of the Analysis of Terms

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Cakkhu cakkhudhātu, dhātū sotadhātu…pe….

The eye is the eye element; the elements are the ear element… etc.

Cakkhu cakkhudhātu, dhātū dhammadhātu. (Yathā āyatanayamake cakkaṃ bandhitaṃ, evamidha cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ.)

The eye is the eye element; the elements are the phenomena element. (As the wheel was bound in the Pairs on Bases, so here the wheel should be bound.)

Paccanīkaṃ

Negative

Na cakkhu na cakkhudhātu, na dhātū na sotadhātu.

The eye is not the eye element; the elements are not the ear element.

Na cakkhu na cakkhudhātu, na dhātū na ghānadhātu…pe….

The eye is not the eye element; the elements are not the nose element… etc.

Na cakkhu na cakkhudhātu, na dhātū na dhammadhātu…pe….

The eye is not the eye element; the elements are not the phenomena element… etc.

Na dhammo na dhammadhātu, na dhātū na cakkhudhātu…pe….

Phenomena are not the phenomena element; the elements are not the eye element… etc.

Na dhammo na dhammadhātu, na dhātū na manoviññāṇadhātu. (Cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ.)

Phenomena are not the phenomena element; the elements are not the mind-consciousness element. (The wheel should be bound.)

Suddhadhātuvāro

Section on Pure Elements

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Cakkhu [V 0.0055] dhātu, dhātū cakkhu…pe….

The eye is an element; the elements are the eye… etc.

Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dhātu, dhātū cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe….

Eye-consciousness is an element; the elements are eye-consciousness… etc.

Manoviññāṇaṃ dhātu, dhātū manoviññāṇaṃ.

Mind-consciousness is an element; the elements are mind-consciousness.

Dhammo dhātu, dhātū dhammo.

Phenomena are an element; the elements are phenomena.

Paccanīkaṃ

Negative

Na cakkhu na dhātu, na dhātū na cakkhu…pe….

The eye is not an element; the elements are not the eye… etc.

Na cakkhuviññāṇaṃ na dhātu, na dhātū na cakkhuviññāṇaṃ…pe….

Eye-consciousness is not an element; the elements are not eye-consciousness… etc.

Na [M 0.0058] manoviññāṇaṃ na dhātu, na dhātū na manoviññāṇaṃ.

Mind-consciousness is not an element; the elements are not mind-consciousness.

Na dhammo na dhātu, na dhātū na dhammo.

Phenomena are not an element; the elements are not phenomena.

Suddhadhātumūlacakkavāro

Section on the Root Wheel of Pure Elements

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Cakkhu dhātu, dhātū sotaṃ…pe….

The eye is an element; the elements are the ear… etc.

Cakkhu dhātu, dhātū dhammo…pe….

The eye is an element; the elements are phenomena… etc.

Dhammo dhātu, dhātū cakkhu…pe….

Phenomena are an element; the elements are the eye… etc.

Dhammo dhātu, dhātū manoviññāṇaṃ. (Cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ.)

Phenomena are an element; the elements are mind-consciousness. (The wheel should be bound.)

Paccanīkaṃ

Negative

Na [V 0.0056] cakkhu na dhātu, na dhātū na sotaṃ…pe….

The eye is not an element; the elements are not the ear… etc.

Na cakkhu na dhātu, na dhātū na dhammo…pe….

The eye is not an element; the elements are not phenomena… etc.

Na dhammo na dhātu, na dhātū na cakkhu…pe….

Phenomena are not an element; the elements are not the eye… etc.

Na dhammo na dhātu, na dhātū na manoviññāṇaṃ. (Cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ. )

Dhamma is not an element; an element is not mind-consciousness. (The wheel should be bound.)

Dhātuyamakamātikā niṭṭhitā.

The Matrix of the Pairs on Elements is finished.

Saccayamakaṃ

The Pairs on the Truths

Paṇṇattivāro

The Section on Designations

Cattāri saccāni (yama. 1.saccayamaka.1 ādayo) – dukkhasaccaṃ samudayasaccaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ maggasaccaṃ.

The Four Truths (Yamaka 1, Saccayamaka 1, etc.): the truth of suffering, the truth of the origin, the truth of cessation, the truth of the path.

Padasodhanavāro

The Section on the Purification of Terms

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Dukkhaṃ [M 0.0059] dukkhasaccaṃ, dukkhasaccaṃ dukkhaṃ.

Suffering is the truth of suffering; the truth of suffering is suffering.

Samudayo samudayasaccaṃ, samudayasaccaṃ samudayo.

The origin is the truth of the origin; the truth of the origin is the origin.

Nirodho nirodhasaccaṃ, nirodhasaccaṃ nirodho.

Cessation is the truth of cessation; the truth of cessation is cessation.

Maggo maggasaccaṃ, maggasaccaṃ maggo.

The path is the truth of the path; the truth of the path is the path.

Paccanīkaṃ

Reverse Order

Na [V 0.0057] dukkhaṃ na dukkhasaccaṃ, na dukkhasaccaṃ na dukkhaṃ.

What is not suffering is not the truth of suffering; and what is not the truth of suffering is not suffering.

Na samudayo na samudayasaccaṃ, na samudayasaccaṃ na samudayo.

What is not the origin is not the truth of the origin; and what is not the truth of the origin is not the origin.

Na nirodho na nirodhasaccaṃ, na nirodhasaccaṃ na nirodho.

What is not cessation is not the truth of cessation; and what is not the truth of cessation is not cessation.

Na maggo na maggasaccaṃ, na maggasaccaṃ na maggo.

What is not the path is not the truth of the path; and what is not the truth of the path is not the path.

Padasodhanamūlacakkavāro

The Section of the Wheel on the Root of Term-Purification

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Dukkhaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, saccā samudayasaccaṃ.

Suffering is the truth of suffering; the origin is the truth of the origin.

Dukkhaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, saccā nirodhasaccaṃ.

Suffering is the truth of suffering; cessation is the truth of cessation.

Dukkhaṃ dukkhasaccaṃ, saccā maggasaccaṃ.

Suffering is the truth of suffering; the path is the truth of the path.

Samudayo samudayasaccaṃ, saccā dukkhasaccaṃ.

The origin is the truth of the origin; suffering is the truth of suffering.

Samudayo samudayasaccaṃ, saccā nirodhasaccaṃ.

The origin is the truth of the origin; cessation is the truth of cessation.

Samudayo samudayasaccaṃ, saccā maggasaccaṃ.

The origin is the truth of the origin; the path is the truth of the path.

Nirodho nirodhasaccaṃ, saccā dukkhasaccaṃ.

Cessation is the truth of cessation; suffering is the truth of suffering.

Nirodho nirodhasaccaṃ, saccā samudayasaccaṃ.

Cessation is the truth of cessation; the origin is the truth of the origin.

Nirodho nirodhasaccaṃ, saccā maggasaccaṃ.

Cessation is the truth of cessation; the path is the truth of the path.

Maggo maggasaccaṃ, saccā dukkhasaccaṃ.

The path is the truth of the path; suffering is the truth of suffering.

Maggo maggasaccaṃ, saccā samudayasaccaṃ.

The path is the truth of the path; the origin is the truth of the origin.

Maggo maggasaccaṃ, saccā nirodhasaccaṃ.

The path is the truth of the path; cessation is the truth of cessation.

Paccanīkaṃ

Negative

Na [M 0.0060][V 0.0058] dukkhaṃ na dukkhasaccaṃ, na saccā na samudayasaccaṃ.

What is not suffering is not the truth of suffering; what is not a truth is not the truth of the origin.

Na dukkhaṃ na dukkhasaccaṃ, na saccā na nirodhasaccaṃ.

What is not suffering is not the truth of suffering; what is not a truth is not the truth of cessation.

Na dukkhaṃ na dukkhasaccaṃ, na saccā na maggasaccaṃ.

What is not suffering is not the truth of suffering; what is not a truth is not the truth of the path.

Na samudayo na samudayasaccaṃ, na saccā na dukkhasaccaṃ.

What is not the origin is not the truth of the origin; what is not a truth is not the truth of suffering.

Na samudayo na samudayasaccaṃ, na saccā na nirodhasaccaṃ.

What is not the origin is not the truth of the origin; what is not a truth is not the truth of cessation.

Na samudayo na samudayasaccaṃ, na saccā na maggasaccaṃ.

What is not the origin is not the truth of the origin; what is not a truth is not the truth of the path.

Na nirodho na nirodhasaccaṃ, na saccā na dukkhasaccaṃ.

What is not cessation is not the truth of cessation; what is not a truth is not the truth of suffering.

Na nirodho na nirodhasaccaṃ, na saccā na samudayasaccaṃ.

What is not cessation is not the truth of cessation; what is not a truth is not the truth of the origin.

Na nirodho na nirodhasaccaṃ, na saccā na maggasaccaṃ.

What is not cessation is not the truth of cessation; what is not a truth is not the truth of the path.

Na maggo na maggasaccaṃ, na saccā na dukkhasaccaṃ.

What is not the path is not the truth of the path; what is not a truth is not the truth of suffering.

Na maggo na maggasaccaṃ, na saccā na samudayasaccaṃ.

What is not the path is not the truth of the path; what is not a truth is not the truth of the origin.

Na maggo na maggasaccaṃ, na saccā na nirodhasaccaṃ.

What is not the path is not the truth of the path; what is not a truth is not the truth of cessation.

Suddhasaccavāro

The Section on Pure Truth

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Dukkhaṃ saccaṃ, saccā dukkhaṃ.

Suffering is a truth; a truth is suffering.

Samudayo saccaṃ, saccā samudayo.

The origin is a truth; a truth is the origin.

Nirodho saccaṃ, saccā nirodho.

Cessation is a truth; a truth is cessation.

Maggo saccaṃ, saccā maggo.

The path is a truth; a truth is the path.

Paccanīkaṃ

Negative

Na [V 0.0059] dukkhaṃ na saccaṃ, na saccā na dukkhaṃ.

What is not suffering is not a truth; what is not a truth is not suffering.

Na samudayo na saccaṃ, na saccā na samudayo.

What is not the origin is not a truth; what is not a truth is not the origin.

Na nirodho na saccaṃ, na saccā na nirodho.

What is not cessation is not a truth; what is not a truth is not cessation.

Na maggo na saccaṃ, na saccā na maggo.

What is not the path is not a truth; what is not a truth is not the path.

Suddhasaccamūlacakkavāro

The Section of the Wheel on the Root of Pure Truth

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Dukkhaṃ [M 0.0061] saccaṃ, saccā samudayo.

Suffering is a truth; a truth is the origin.

Dukkhaṃ saccaṃ, saccā nirodho.

Suffering is a truth; a truth is cessation.

Dukkhaṃ saccaṃ, saccā maggo.

Suffering is a truth; a truth is the path.

Samudayo saccaṃ, saccā dukkhaṃ…pe… saccā maggo.

The origin is a truth; a truth is suffering… and so on… a truth is the path.

Nirodho saccaṃ, saccā dukkhaṃ…pe… saccā maggo.

Cessation is a truth; a truth is suffering… and so on… a truth is the path.

Maggo saccaṃ, saccā dukkhaṃ.

The path is a truth; a truth is suffering.

Maggo saccaṃ, saccā samudayo.

The path is a truth; a truth is the origin.

Maggo saccaṃ, saccā nirodho.

The path is a truth; a truth is cessation.

Paccanīkaṃ

Negative

Na dukkhaṃ na saccaṃ, na saccā na samudayo.

What is not suffering is not a truth; not a truth is not the origin.

Na dukkhaṃ na saccaṃ, na saccā na nirodho.

What is not suffering is not a truth; not a truth is not cessation.

Na dukkhaṃ na saccaṃ, na saccā na maggo.

What is not suffering is not a truth; not a truth is not the path.

Na [V 0.0060] samudayo na saccaṃ, na saccā na dukkhaṃ…pe… na saccā na maggo.

What is not the origin is not a truth; not a truth is not suffering… and so on… not a truth is not the path.

Na nirodho na saccaṃ, na saccā na dukkhaṃ…pe… na saccā na maggo.

What is not cessation is not a truth; not a truth is not suffering… and so on… not a truth is not the path.

Na maggo na saccaṃ, na saccā na dukkhaṃ.

What is not the path is not a truth; not a truth is not suffering.

Na maggo na saccaṃ, na saccā na samudayo.

What is not the path is not a truth; not a truth is not the origin.

Na maggo na saccaṃ, na saccā na nirodho.

What is not the path is not a truth; not a truth is not cessation.

Saccayamakamātikā niṭṭhitā.

The matrix of the Pairs on the Truths is finished.

Saṅkhārayamakaṃ

The Pairs on Formations

Paṇṇattivāro

The Section on Designations

Tayo [M 0.0062] saṅkhārā (yama. 2.saṅkhārayamaka.1 ādayo) – kāyasaṅkhāro vacīsaṅkhāro cittasaṅkhāro. Assāsapassāsā kāyasaṅkhāro, vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro, saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhāro, ṭhapetvā vitakkavicāre sabbepi cittasampayuttakā dhammā cittasaṅkhāro.

There are three formations (Yamaka 2, Pairs on Formations 1, etc.): bodily formation, verbal formation, and mental formation. In-breathing and out-breathing are the bodily formation; initial thought and sustained thought are the verbal formation; perception and feeling are the mental formation; excluding initial and sustained thought, all mental concomitants are the mental formation.

Padasodhanavāro

The Section on Word Analysis

Anulomaṃ

Positive

Kāyo kāyasaṅkhāro, kāyasaṅkhāro kāyo.

The body is a bodily formation; a bodily formation is the body.

Vacī vacīsaṅkhāro, vacīsaṅkhāro vacī.

Speech is a verbal formation; a verbal formation is speech.

Cittaṃ cittasaṅkhāro, cittasaṅkhāro cittaṃ.

The mind is a mental formation; a mental formation is the mind.

Paccanīkaṃ

Negative

Na [V 0.0061] kāyo na kāyasaṅkhāro, na kāyasaṅkhāro na kāyo.

What is not the body is not a bodily formation; what is not a bodily formation is not the body.

Na vacī na vacīsaṅkhāro, na vacīsaṅkhāro na vacī.

What is not speech is not a verbal formation; what is not a verbal formation is not speech.

Na cittaṃ na cittasaṅkhāro, na cittasaṅkhāro na cittaṃ.

What is not the mind is not a mental formation; what is not a mental formation is not the mind.

Padasodhanamūlacakkavāro

The Section on Word Analysis with the Root Wheel

Anulomaṃ

Positive

Kāyo kāyasaṅkhāro, saṅkhārā vacīsaṅkhāro.

The body is a bodily formation; formations are a verbal formation.

Kāyo kāyasaṅkhāro, saṅkhārā cittasaṅkhāro.

The body is a bodily formation; formations are a mental formation.

Vacī vacīsaṅkhāro, saṅkhārā kāyasaṅkhāro.

Speech is a verbal formation; volitional formations are a bodily formation.

Vacī vacīsaṅkhāro, saṅkhārā cittasaṅkhāro.

Speech is a verbal formation; volitional formations are a mental formation.

Cittaṃ [M 0.0063] cittasaṅkhāro, saṅkhārā kāyasaṅkhāro.

The mind is a mental formation; volitional formations are a bodily formation.

Cittaṃ cittasaṅkhāro, saṅkhārā vacīsaṅkhāro.

The mind is a mental formation; volitional formations are a verbal formation.

Paccanīkaṃ

Antithetical

Na kāyo na kāyasaṅkhāro, na saṅkhārā na vacīsaṅkhāro.

Not the body, not a bodily formation; not volitional formations, not a verbal formation.

Na kāyo na kāyasaṅkhāro, na saṅkhārā na cittasaṅkhāro.

Not the body, not a bodily formation; not volitional formations, not a mental formation.

Na vacī na vacīsaṅkhāro, na saṅkhārā na kāyasaṅkhāro.

Not speech, not a verbal formation; not volitional formations, not a bodily formation.

Na vacī na vacīsaṅkhāro, na saṅkhārā na cittasaṅkhāro.

Not speech, not a verbal formation; not volitional formations, not a mental formation.

Na cittaṃ na cittasaṅkhāro, na saṅkhārā na kāyasaṅkhāro.

Not the mind, not a mental formation; not volitional formations, not a bodily formation.

Na cittaṃ na cittasaṅkhāro, na saṅkhārā na vacīsaṅkhāro.

Not the mind, not a mental formation; not volitional formations, not a verbal formation.

Suddhasaṅkhāravāro

The Section on Pure Formations

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Kāyasaṅkhāro [V 0.0062] vacīsaṅkhāro, vacīsaṅkhāro kāyasaṅkhāro.

A bodily formation is a verbal formation; a verbal formation is a bodily formation.

Kāyasaṅkhāro cittasaṅkhāro, cittasaṅkhāro kāyasaṅkhāro.

A bodily formation is a mental formation; a mental formation is a bodily formation.

Vacīsaṅkhāro cittasaṅkhāro, cittasaṅkhāro vacīsaṅkhāro.

A verbal formation is a mental formation; a mental formation is a verbal formation.

Paccanīkaṃ

Antithetical

Na kāyasaṅkhāro na vacīsaṅkhāro, na vacīsaṅkhāro na kāyasaṅkhāro.

Not a bodily formation, not a verbal formation; not a verbal formation, not a bodily formation.

Na kāyasaṅkhāro na cittasaṅkhāro, na cittasaṅkhāro na kāyasaṅkhāro.

Not a bodily formation, not a mental formation; not a mental formation, not a bodily formation.

Na vacīsaṅkhāro na cittasaṅkhāro, na cittasaṅkhāro na vacīsaṅkhāro.

Not a verbal formation, not a mental formation; not a mental formation, not a verbal formation.

Saṅkhārayamakamātikā niṭṭhitā.

The Matrix of the Pairs on Formations is completed.

Anusayayamakaṃ

The Pairs on Latent Tendencies

Sattānusayā [M 0.0064] (yama. 2.anusayayamaka.1) – kāmarāgānusayo paṭighānusayo mānānusayo diṭṭhānusayo vicikicchānusayo bhavarāgānusayo avijjānusayo.

Seven latent tendencies: the latent tendency of sensual lust, the latent tendency of aversion, the latent tendency of conceit, the latent tendency of views, the latent tendency of doubt, the latent tendency of craving for existence, the latent tendency of ignorance.

Anusayayamakamātikā niṭṭhitā.

The Matrix of the Pairs on Latent Tendencies is completed.

Cittayamakaṃ

The Pairs on Consciousness

Suddhacittasāmaññaṃ

The General Section on Pure Consciousness

Puggalavāro

The Section on Individuals

1. Uppādanirodhakālasambhedavāro

1. The Section on the Conjunction of the Times of Arising and Ceasing

Yassa [V 0.0063] cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati (yama. 2.cittayamaka.1 ādayo), tassa cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissati, tassa cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati.

For one for whom consciousness arises but does not cease, for them will consciousness cease but not arise? Or, for one for whom consciousness will cease but not arise, for them does consciousness arise but not cease?

Yassa cittaṃ na uppajjati nirujjhati, tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhissati uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati uppajjissati, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjati nirujjhati.

For one for whom consciousness does not arise but ceases, for them will consciousness not cease but arise? Or, for one for whom consciousness will not cease but arise, for them does consciousness not arise but cease?

2. Uppāduppannavāro

2. The Section on Arising and the Arisen.

Yassa cittaṃ uppajjati, tassa cittaṃ uppannaṃ. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ uppajjati.

For whom a mind arises, for them a mind has arisen. Or, for whom a mind has arisen, for them a mind arises.

Yassa cittaṃ na uppajjati, tassa cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjati.

For whom a mind does not arise, for them a mind has not arisen. Or, for whom a mind has not arisen, for them a mind does not arise.

3. Nirodhuppannavāro

3. The Section on Ceasing and the Arisen.

Yassa [M 0.0065] cittaṃ nirujjhati, tassa cittaṃ uppannaṃ. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ nirujjhati.

For whom a mind ceases, for them a mind has arisen. Or, for whom a mind has arisen, for them a mind ceases.

Yassa [V 0.0064] cittaṃ na nirujjhati, tassa cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhati.

For whom a mind does not cease, for them a mind has not arisen. Or, for whom a mind has not arisen, for them a mind does not cease.

4. Uppādavāro

4. The Section on Arising.

Yassa cittaṃ uppajjati, tassa cittaṃ uppajjittha. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppajjittha, tassa cittaṃ uppajjati.

For whom a mind arises, for them a mind arose. Or, for whom a mind arose, for them a mind arises.

Yassa cittaṃ na uppajjati, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjittha. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjittha, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjati.

For whom a mind does not arise, for them a mind did not arise. Or, for whom a mind did not arise, for them a mind does not arise.

Yassa cittaṃ uppajjati, tassa cittaṃ uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati, tassa cittaṃ uppajjati.

For whom a mind arises, for them a mind will arise. Or, for whom a mind will arise, for them a mind arises.

Yassa cittaṃ na uppajjati, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjati.

For whom a mind does not arise, for them a mind will not arise. Or, for whom a mind will not arise, for them a mind does not arise.

Yassa cittaṃ uppajjittha, tassa cittaṃ uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati, tassa cittaṃ uppajjittha.

For whom a mind arose, for them a mind will arise. Or, for whom a mind will arise, for them a mind arose.

Yassa cittaṃ na uppajjittha, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjittha.

For whom a mind did not arise, for them a mind will not arise. Or, for whom a mind will not arise, for them a mind did not arise.

5. Nirodhavāro

5. The Section on Cessation.

Yassa cittaṃ nirujjhati, tassa cittaṃ nirujjhittha. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhittha, tassa cittaṃ nirujjhati.

For whom a mind ceases, for them a mind ceased. Or, for whom a mind ceased, for them a mind ceases.

Yassa cittaṃ na nirujjhati, tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhittha. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhittha, tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhati.

For whom a mind does not cease, for them a mind did not cease. Or, for whom a mind did not cease, for them a mind does not cease.

Yassa cittaṃ nirujjhati, tassa cittaṃ nirujjhissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati, tassa cittaṃ nirujjhati.

For whom a mind ceases, for them a mind will cease. Or, for whom a mind will cease, for them a mind ceases.

Yassa [M 0.0066][V 0.0065] cittaṃ na nirujjhati, tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhati.

For whom a mind does not cease, for them a mind will not cease. Or, for whom a mind will not cease, for them a mind does not cease.

Yassa cittaṃ nirujjhittha, tassa cittaṃ nirujjhissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati, tassa cittaṃ nirujjhittha.

For whom a mind ceased, for them a mind will cease. Or, for whom a mind will cease, for them a mind ceased.

Yassa cittaṃ na nirujjhittha, tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhittha.

For whom a mind did not cease, for them a mind will not cease. Or, for whom a mind will not cease, for them a mind did not cease.

6. Uppādanirodhavāro

6. The Section on Arising and Cessation.

Yassa cittaṃ uppajjati, tassa cittaṃ nirujjhittha. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhittha, tassa cittaṃ uppajjati.

For whom a mind arises, for them a mind ceased. Or, for whom a mind ceased, for them a mind arises.

Yassa cittaṃ na uppajjati, tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhittha. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhittha, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjati.

For whom a mind does not arise, for them a mind did not cease. Or, for whom a mind did not cease, for them a mind does not arise.

Yassa cittaṃ uppajjati, tassa cittaṃ nirujjhissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati, tassa cittaṃ uppajjati.

For whom a mind arises, for them a mind will cease. Or, for whom a mind will cease, for them a mind arises.

Yassa cittaṃ na uppajjati, tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjati.

For whom a mind does not arise, for them a mind will not cease. Or, for whom a mind will not cease, for them a mind does not arise.

Yassa cittaṃ uppajjittha, tassa cittaṃ nirujjhissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati, tassa cittaṃ uppajjittha.

For whom a mind arose, for them a mind will cease. Or, for whom a mind will cease, for them a mind arose.

Yassa cittaṃ na uppajjittha, tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjittha.

For whom a mind did not arise, for them a mind will not cease. Or, for whom a mind will not cease, for them a mind did not arise.

7. Uppajjamānananirodhavāro

7. The Section on the Arising and the Ceasing.

Yassa [V 0.0066] cittaṃ uppajjati, tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhati, tassa cittaṃ uppajjati.

For whom a mind arises, for them a mind does not cease. Or, for whom a mind does not cease, for them a mind arises.

Yassa cittaṃ na uppajjati, tassa cittaṃ nirujjhati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhati, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjati.

For whom a mind does not arise, for them a mind ceases. Or, for whom a mind ceases, for them a mind does not arise.

8. Uppajjamānuppannavāro

8. The Section on the Arising and the Arisen

Yassa [M 0.0067] cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ, tassa cittaṃ uppannaṃ. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ.

For one whose consciousness is arising, his consciousness has arisen. Or conversely, for one whose consciousness has arisen, his consciousness is arising.

Yassa cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ, tassa cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ.

For one whose consciousness is not arising, his consciousness has not arisen. Or conversely, for one whose consciousness has not arisen, his consciousness is not arising.

9. Nirujjhamānuppannavāro

9. The Section on the Ceasing and the Arisen

Yassa cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ, tassa cittaṃ uppannaṃ. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ.

For one whose consciousness is ceasing, his consciousness has arisen. Or conversely, for one whose consciousness has arisen, his consciousness is ceasing.

Yassa cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ, tassa cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ.

For one whose consciousness is not ceasing, his consciousness has not arisen. Or conversely, for one whose consciousness has not arisen, his consciousness is not ceasing.

10. Uppannuppādavāro

10. The Section on the Arisen and Arising

Yassa cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ uppajjittha. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppajjittha, tassa cittaṃ uppannaṃ.

For one whose consciousness has arisen, his consciousness arose. Or conversely, for one whose consciousness arose, his consciousness has arisen.

Yassa [V 0.0067] cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjittha. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjittha, tassa cittaṃ na uppannaṃ.

For one whose consciousness has not arisen, his consciousness did not arise. Or conversely, for one whose consciousness did not arise, his consciousness has not arisen.

Yassa cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati, tassa cittaṃ uppannaṃ.

For one whose consciousness has arisen, his consciousness will arise. Or conversely, for one whose consciousness will arise, his consciousness has arisen.

Yassa cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati, tassa cittaṃ na uppannaṃ.

For one whose consciousness has not arisen, his consciousness will not arise. Or conversely, for one whose consciousness will not arise, his consciousness has not arisen.

11. Atītānāgatavāro

11. The Section on the Past and Future

Yassa cittaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tassa cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tassa cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ uppajjittha.

For one whose consciousness arose but has not arisen, his consciousness will arise. Or conversely, for one whose consciousness will arise but has not arisen, his consciousness arose.

Yassa [M 0.0068] cittaṃ na uppajjittha, no ca tassa cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati, no ca tassa cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjittha.

For one whose consciousness did not arise but has arisen, his consciousness will not arise. Or conversely, for one whose consciousness will not arise but has arisen, his consciousness did not arise.

12. Uppannuppajjamānavāro

12. The Section on the Arisen and the Arising

Uppannaṃ uppajjamānaṃ, uppajjamānaṃ uppannaṃ.

The arisen is the arising; the arising is the arisen.

Na uppannaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ, na uppajjamānaṃ na uppannaṃ.

What has not arisen is not arising; what is not arising has not arisen.

13. Niruddhanirujjhamānavāro

13. The Section on the Ceased and the Ceasing

Niruddhaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ, nirujjhamānaṃ niruddhaṃ.

The ceased is the ceasing; the ceasing is the ceased.

Na niruddhaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ, na nirujjhamānaṃ na niruddhaṃ.

What has not ceased is not ceasing; what is not ceasing has not ceased.

14. Atikkantakālavāro

14. The Section on Past Time

Yassa [V 0.0068] cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa cittaṃ. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa cittaṃ.

For one whose mind is arising, moment by moment passed, belonging to past time, and ceasing, moment by moment passed, belonging to past time, for him is that mind. Or conversely, for one whose mind is ceasing, moment by moment passed, belonging to past time, and arising, moment by moment passed, belonging to past time, for him is that mind.

Yassa cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, na nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa cittaṃ. Yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, na uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa cittaṃ.

For one whose mind is not arising, moment by moment passed, belonging to past time, and not ceasing, moment by moment passed, belonging to past time, for him is that mind. Or conversely, for one whose mind is not ceasing, moment by moment passed, belonging to past time, and not arising, moment by moment passed, belonging to past time, for him is that mind.

Suddhacittasāmaññaṃ

The Generality of the Pure Mind

Dhammavāro

The Section on Phenomena

1. Uppādanirodhakālasambhedavāro

1. The Section on the Distinction of Time regarding Arising and Ceasing

Yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati, taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissati, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati.

Whatever mind arises but does not cease, that mind will cease but will not arise. Or conversely, whatever mind will cease but will not arise, that mind arises but does not cease.

Yaṃ [M 0.0069] cittaṃ na uppajjati nirujjhati, taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati uppajjissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati uppajjissati, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati nirujjhati.

Whatever mind does not arise but does cease, that mind will not cease but will arise. Or conversely, whatever mind will not cease but will arise, that mind does not arise but does cease.

2. Uppāduppannavāro

2. The Section on Arising and the Arisen

Yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati, taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati.

Whatever mind arises, that mind has arisen. Or conversely, whatever mind has arisen, that mind arises.

Yaṃ [V 0.0069] cittaṃ na uppajjati, taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati.

Whatever mind does not arise, that mind has not arisen. Or whatever mind has not arisen, that mind does not arise.

3. Nirodhuppannavāro

3. The Section on Ceasing and the Arisen

Yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati, taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati.

Whatever mind ceases, that mind has arisen. Or whatever mind has arisen, that mind ceases.

Yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati, taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati.

Whatever mind does not cease, that mind has not arisen. Or whatever mind has not arisen, that mind does not cease.

4. Uppādavāro

4. The Section on Arising

Yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppajjittha, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati.

Whatever mind arises, that mind arose. Or whatever mind arose, that mind arises.

Yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjittha, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati.

Whatever mind does not arise, that mind did not arise. Or whatever mind did not arise, that mind does not arise.

Yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati.

Whatever mind arises, that mind will arise. Or whatever mind will arise, that mind arises.

Yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati.

Whatever mind does not arise, that mind will not arise. Or whatever mind will not arise, that mind does not arise.

Yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha.

Whatever mind arose, that mind will arise. Or whatever mind will arise, that mind arose.

Yaṃ [M 0.0070][V 0.0070] cittaṃ na uppajjittha, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha.

Whatever mind did not arise, that mind will not arise. Or whatever mind will not arise, that mind did not arise.

5. Nirodhavāro

5. The Section on Cessation

Yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati, taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhittha. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhittha, taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati.

Whatever mind ceases, that mind ceased. Or whatever mind ceased, that mind ceases.

Yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati, taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhittha. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhittha, taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati.

Whatever mind does not cease, that mind did not cease. Or whatever mind did not cease, that mind does not cease.

Yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati, taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati, taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati.

Whatever mind ceases, that mind will cease. Or whatever mind will cease, that mind ceases.

Yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati, taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati.

Whatever mind does not cease, that mind will not cease. Or whatever mind will not cease, that mind does not cease.

Yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhittha, taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati, taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhittha.

Whatever mind ceased, that mind will cease. Or whatever mind will cease, that mind ceased.

Yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhittha, taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhittha.

Whatever mind did not cease, that mind will not cease. Or whatever mind will not cease, that mind did not cease.

6. Uppādanirodhavāro

6. The Section on Arising and Cessation

Yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati, taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhittha. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhittha, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati.

Whatever mind arises, that mind ceased. Or whatever mind ceased, that mind arises.

Yaṃ [V 0.0071] cittaṃ na uppajjati, taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhittha. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhittha, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati.

Whatever mind does not arise, that mind did not cease. Or whatever mind did not cease, that mind does not arise.

Yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati, taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati.

Whatever mind arises, that mind will cease. Or whatever mind will cease, that mind arises.

Yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati.

Whatever mind does not arise, that mind will not cease. Or whatever mind will not cease, that mind does not arise.

Yaṃ [M 0.0071] cittaṃ uppajjittha, taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha.

Whatever mind arose, that mind will cease. Or whatever mind will cease, that mind arose.

Yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha, taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha.

Whatever mind did not arise, that mind will not cease. Or whatever mind will not cease, that mind did not arise.

7. Uppajjamānananirodhavāro

7. The Section on the Arising and Not-Ceasing

Yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati, taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhati, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati.

Whatever mind arises, that mind does not cease. Or whatever mind does not cease, that mind arises.

Yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhati, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati.

Whatever mind does not arise, that mind ceases. Or whatever mind ceases, that mind does not arise.

8. Uppajjamānuppannavāro

8. The Section on the Arising and the Arisen

Yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ.

Whatever mind is arising, that mind is arisen. Or whatever mind is arisen, that mind is arising.

Yaṃ [V 0.0072] cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ.

Whatever mind is not arising, that mind is not arisen. Or whatever mind is not arisen, that mind is not arising.

9. Nirujjhamānuppannavāro

9. The Section on the Ceasing and the Arisen

Yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ.

Whatever mind is ceasing, that mind is arisen. Or whatever mind is arisen, that mind is ceasing.

Yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ.

Whatever mind is not ceasing, that mind is not arisen. Or whatever mind is not arisen, that mind is not ceasing.

10. Uppannuppādavāro

10. The Section on the Arisen and Arising

Yaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppajjittha, taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ.

Whatever mind is arisen, that mind arose. Or whatever mind arose, that mind is arisen.

Yaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjittha, taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ.

Whatever mind has not arisen, that mind did not arise. Or whatever mind did not arise, that mind has not arisen.

Yaṃ [M 0.0072] cittaṃ uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati, taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ.

Whatever mind has arisen, that mind will arise. Or whatever mind will arise, that mind has arisen.

Yaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati, taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ.

Whatever mind has not arisen, that mind will not arise. Or whatever mind will not arise, that mind has not arisen.

11. Atītānāgatavāro

11. The Section on the Past and Future

Yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha, no ca taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha.

Whatever mind arose, but that mind is not arisen, that mind will arise. Or whatever mind will arise, but that mind is not arisen, that mind arose.

Yaṃ [V 0.0073] cittaṃ na uppajjittha, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha.

Whatever mind did not arise, and that mind is arisen, that mind will not arise. Or whatever mind will not arise, and that mind is arisen, that mind did not arise.

12. Uppannuppajjamānavāro

12. The Section on the Arisen and the Arising

Uppannaṃ uppajjamānaṃ, uppajjamānaṃ uppannaṃ.

What has arisen is arising; what is arising has arisen.

Na uppannaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ, na uppajjamānaṃ na uppannaṃ.

What has not arisen is not arising; what is not arising has not arisen.

13. Niruddhanirujjhamānavāro

13. The Section on the Ceased and the Ceasing

Niruddhaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ, nirujjhamānaṃ niruddhaṃ.

What has ceased is ceasing; what is ceasing has ceased.

Na niruddhaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ, na nirujjhamānaṃ na niruddhaṃ.

What has not ceased is not ceasing; what is not ceasing has not ceased.

14. Atikkantakālavāro

14. The Section on Past Time

Yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ taṃ cittaṃ. Yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ taṃ cittaṃ.

That mind which, arising moment by moment, has passed into past time; that mind which, ceasing moment by moment, has passed into past time—that is that mind. Or again, that mind which, ceasing moment by moment, has passed into past time; that mind which, arising moment by moment, has passed into past time—that is that mind.

Yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, na nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ taṃ cittaṃ. Yaṃ vā [M 0.0073] pana cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, na uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ taṃ cittaṃ.

That mind which, not arising moment by moment, has passed into past time; that mind which, not ceasing moment by moment, has passed into past time—that is that mind. Or again, that mind which, not ceasing moment by moment, has passed into past time; that mind which, not arising moment by moment, has passed into past time—that is that mind.

Suddhacittasāmaññaṃ

The Generality of Pure Mind

For whom a certain mind does not arise, for them that mind will not cease. Or again, for whom a certain mind will not cease, for them that mind does not arise.

Yassa yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha, tassa taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati, tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha.

For whom a certain mind arose, for them that mind will cease. Or again, for whom a certain mind will cease, for them that mind arose.

Yassa [V 0.0077] yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha.

For whom a certain mind did not arise, for them that mind will not cease. Or again, for whom a certain mind will not cease, for them that mind did not arise.

7. Uppajjamānananirodhavāro

7. The Section on the Arising Moment and Cessation.

Yassa yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati, tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati.

For whom a certain mind arises, for them that mind does not cease. Or again, for whom a certain mind does not cease, for them that mind arises.

Yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, tassa taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati.

For whom a certain mind does not arise, for them that mind ceases. Or again, for whom a certain mind ceases, for them that mind does not arise.

8. Uppajjamānuppannavāro

8. The Section on Arising and Arisen.

Yassa yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ.

For whom a certain mind is arising, for them that mind has arisen. Or again, for whom a certain mind has arisen, for them that mind is arising.

Yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ.

For whom a certain mind is not arising, for them that mind has not arisen. Or again, for whom a certain mind has not arisen, for them that mind is not arising.

9. Nirujjhamānuppannavāro

9. The Section on Ceasing and Arisen.

Yassa [M 0.0076] yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ.

For whom a certain mind is ceasing, for them that mind has arisen. Or for whom a certain mind has arisen, for them that mind is ceasing.

Yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ.

For whom a certain mind is not ceasing, for them that mind has not arisen. Or for whom a certain mind has not arisen, for them that mind is not ceasing.

10. Uppannuppādavāro

10. The Section on Arisen and Arising

Yassa [V 0.0078] yaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha, tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ.

For whom a certain mind has arisen, for them that mind arose. Or for whom a certain mind arose, for them that mind has arisen.

Yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ.

For whom a certain mind has not arisen, for them that mind did not arise. Or for whom a certain mind did not arise, for them that mind has not arisen.

Yassa yaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati, tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ.

For whom a certain mind has arisen, for them that mind will arise. Or for whom a certain mind will arise, for them that mind has arisen.

Yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati, yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ.

For whom a certain mind has not arisen, for them that mind will not arise. Or for whom a certain mind will not arise, for them that mind has not arisen.

11. Atītānāgatavāro

11. The Section on the Past and Future

Yassa yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha.

For whom a certain mind arose, but for them that mind has not arisen, for them that mind will arise. Or for whom a certain mind will arise, but for them that mind has not arisen, for them that mind arose.

Yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha.

For whom a certain mind did not arise, but for whom that mind has arisen, for them that mind will not arise. Or for whom a certain mind will not arise, but for whom that mind has arisen, for them that mind did not arise.

12. Uppannuppajjamānavāro

12. The Section on Arisen and Arising

Uppannaṃ uppajjamānaṃ, uppajjamānaṃ uppannaṃ.

What has arisen is arising, what is arising has arisen.

Na uppannaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ, na uppajjamānaṃ na uppannaṃ.

What has not arisen is not arising, what is not arising has not arisen.

13. Niruddhanirujjhamānavāro

13. The Section on Ceased and Ceasing

Niruddhaṃ [M 0.0077][V 0.0079] nirujjhamānaṃ, nirujjhamānaṃ niruddhaṃ.

What has ceased is ceasing, what is ceasing has ceased.

Na niruddhaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ, na nirujjhamānaṃ na niruddhaṃ.

What has not ceased is not ceasing, what is not ceasing has not ceased.

14. Atikkantakālavāro

14. The Section on Past Time

Yassa yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ.

For whom a certain mind, arising, has passed away moment by moment into past time, and ceasing, has passed away moment by moment into past time, for them is that mind. Or for whom a certain mind, ceasing, has passed away moment by moment into past time, and arising, has passed away moment by moment into past time, for them is that mind.

Yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, na nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ. Yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, na uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ.

For whom a certain mind is not arising, elapsing moment by moment into past time, nor ceasing, elapsing moment by moment into past time, for them is that mind. Or for whom a certain mind is not ceasing, elapsing moment by moment into past time, nor arising, elapsing moment by moment into past time, for them is that mind.

Suttantacittamissakaviseso

The Special Section on Mixed States of Mind (Suttanta Method)

Yassa sarāgaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati…pe… yassa vītarāgaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa sadosaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa vītadosaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa samohaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa vītamohaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa saṃkhittaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa vikkhittaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa mahaggataṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa amahaggataṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa sauttaraṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa anuttaraṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa samāhitaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa asamāhitaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa vimuttaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa avimuttaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati.

For whom a mind with lust arises... for whom a mind without lust arises. For whom a mind with aversion arises. For whom a mind without aversion arises. For whom a mind with delusion arises. For whom a mind without delusion arises. For whom a contracted mind arises. For whom a distracted mind arises. For whom a sublime mind arises. For whom a non-sublime mind arises. For whom a mind with a superior arises. For whom an unsurpassed mind arises. For whom a concentrated mind arises. For whom an unconcentrated mind arises. For whom a liberated mind arises. For whom an unliberated mind arises.

Abhidhammacittamissakaviseso

The Special Section on Mixed States of Mind (Abhidhamma Method)

Yassa [M 0.0078][V 0.0080] kusalaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati…pe… yassa akusalaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa abyākataṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Yassa sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati.

For whom a wholesome mind arises... for whom an unwholesome mind arises. For whom an indeterminate mind arises. For whom a mind associated with pleasant feeling arises.

(Etena upāyena yāva saraṇaaraṇā uddharitabbā.)

(By this method, they should be extended up to the states with defilements and without defilements.)

Yassa araṇaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati, tassa araṇaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissati. Yassa vā pana araṇaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissati, tassa araṇaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati.

For whom a mind free from defilements arises and does not cease, for them a mind free from defilements will cease and not arise. Or for whom a mind free from defilements will cease and not arise, for them a mind free from defilements arises and does not cease.

Cittayamakamātikā niṭṭhitā.

The Matrix of the Pairs on Mind is concluded.

Dhammayamakaṃ

The Pairs on Phenomena

Paṇṇattivāro

The Section on Designation

Padasodhanavāro

The Section on Analysis of Terms

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Kusalā kusalā dhammā (yama. 3.dhammayamaka.1 ādayo). Kusalā dhammā kusalā.

Wholesome are wholesome phenomena. Wholesome phenomena are wholesome.

Akusalā akusalā dhammā. Akusalā dhammā akusalā.

Unwholesome are unwholesome phenomena. Unwholesome phenomena are unwholesome.

Abyākatā abyākatā dhammā. Abyākatā dhammā abyākatā.

Indeterminate are indeterminate phenomena. Indeterminate phenomena are indeterminate.

Paccanīkaṃ

The Negative

Na [V 0.0081] kusalā na kusalā dhammā. Na kusalā dhammā na kusalā.

Not wholesome are not wholesome phenomena. Not wholesome phenomena are not wholesome.

Na [M 0.0079] akusalā na akusalā dhammā. Na akusalā dhammā na akusalā.

Not unwholesome are not unwholesome phenomena. Not unwholesome phenomena are not unwholesome.

Na abyākatā na abyākatā dhammā. Na abyākatā dhammā na abyākatā.

Not indeterminate are not indeterminate phenomena. Not indeterminate phenomena are not indeterminate.

Padasodhanamūlacakkavāro

The Section on Word Analysis with the Root Cycle

Anulomaṃ

The Positive

Kusalā kusalā dhammā. Dhammā akusalā dhammā.

Wholesome are wholesome phenomena. Phenomena are unwholesome phenomena.

Kusalā kusalā dhammā. Dhammā abyākatā dhammā.

Wholesome are wholesome phenomena. Phenomena are indeterminate phenomena.

Akusalā akusalā dhammā. Dhammā kusalā dhammā.

Unwholesome are unwholesome phenomena. Phenomena are wholesome phenomena.

Akusalā akusalā dhammā. Dhammā abyākatā dhammā.

Unwholesome are unwholesome phenomena. Phenomena are indeterminate phenomena.

Abyākatā abyākatā dhammā. Dhammā kusalā dhammā.

Indeterminate are indeterminate phenomena. Phenomena are wholesome phenomena.

Abyākatā abyākatā dhammā. Dhammā akusalā dhammā.

Indeterminate are indeterminate phenomena. Phenomena are unwholesome phenomena.

Paccanīkaṃ

The Negative

Na kusalā na kusalā dhammā. Na dhammā na akusalā dhammā.

Not wholesome are not wholesome phenomena. Not phenomena are not unwholesome phenomena.

Na kusalā na kusalā dhammā. Na dhammā na abyākatā dhammā.

Not wholesome are not wholesome phenomena. Not phenomena are not indeterminate phenomena.

Na akusalā na akusalā dhammā. Na dhammā na kusalā dhammā.

Not unwholesome are not unwholesome phenomena. Not phenomena are not wholesome phenomena.

Na akusalā na akusalā dhammā. Na dhammā na abyākatā dhammā.

Not unwholesome are not unwholesome phenomena. Not phenomena are not indeterminate phenomena.

Na abyākatā na abyākatā dhammā. Na dhammā na kusalā dhammā.

Not indeterminate are not indeterminate phenomena. Not phenomena are not wholesome phenomena.

Na abyākatā na abyākatā dhammā. Na dhammā na akusalā dhammā.

Not indeterminate are not indeterminate phenomena. Not phenomena are not unwholesome phenomena.

Suddhadhammavāro

The Section on Pure Phenomena

Anulomaṃ

The Positive

Kusalā [M 0.0080][V 0.0082] dhammā. Dhammā kusalā.

Wholesome phenomena. Phenomena are wholesome.

Akusalā dhammā. Dhammā akusalā.

Unwholesome phenomena. Phenomena are unwholesome.

Abyākatā dhammā. Dhammā abyākatā.

Indeterminate phenomena. Phenomena are indeterminate.

Paccanīkaṃ

The Negative

Na kusalā na dhammā. Na dhammā na kusalā.

Not wholesome are not phenomena. Not phenomena are not wholesome.

Na akusalā na dhammā. Na dhammā na akusalā.

Not unwholesome are not phenomena. Not phenomena are not unwholesome.

Na abyākatā na dhammā. Na dhammā na abyākatā.

Things not indeterminate are not phenomena. Things not phenomena are not indeterminate.

Suddhadhammamūlacakkavāro

The Section of the Root Cycle on Pure Phenomena.

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order.

Kusalā dhammā. Dhammā akusalā.

Wholesome phenomena. Phenomena are unwholesome.

Kusalā dhammā. Dhammā abyākatā.

Wholesome phenomena. Phenomena are indeterminate.

Akusalā dhammā. Dhammā kusalā.

Unwholesome phenomena. Phenomena are wholesome.

Akusalā dhammā. Dhammā abyākatā.

Unwholesome phenomena. Phenomena are indeterminate.

Abyākatā dhammā. Dhammā kusalā.

Indeterminate phenomena. Phenomena are wholesome.

Abyākatā dhammā. Dhammā akusalā.

Indeterminate phenomena. Phenomena are unwholesome.

Paccanīkaṃ

Reverse Order.

Na [V 0.0083] kusalā na dhammā. Na dhammā na akusalā.

Things not wholesome are not phenomena. Things not phenomena are not unwholesome.

Na kusalā na dhammā. Na dhammā na abyākatā.

Things not wholesome are not phenomena. Things not phenomena are not indeterminate.

Na akusalā na dhammā. Na dhammā na kusalā.

Things not unwholesome are not phenomena. Things not phenomena are not wholesome.

Na akusalā na dhammā. Na dhammā na abyākatā.

Things not unwholesome are not phenomena. Things not phenomena are not indeterminate.

Na abyākatā na dhammā. Na dhammā na kusalā.

Things not indeterminate are not phenomena. Things not phenomena are not wholesome.

Na abyākatā na dhammā. Na dhammā na akusalā.

Things not indeterminate are not phenomena. Things not phenomena are not unwholesome.

Dhammayamakamātikā niṭṭhitā.

The Matrix of the Yamaka on Phenomena is concluded.

Indriyayamakaṃ

The Yamaka on Faculties.

Paṇṇattivāro

The Section on Designation.

Bāvīsatindriyāni [M 0.0081] (yama. 3.indriyayamaka.1 ādayo) – cakkhundriyaṃ sotindriyaṃ ghānindriyaṃ jivhindriyaṃ kāyindriyaṃ manindriyaṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ sukhindriyaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ somanassindriyaṃ domanassindriyaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ saddhindriyaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ samādhindriyaṃ paññindriyaṃ anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ aññindriyaṃ aññātāvindriyaṃ.

Twenty-two faculties (yama. 3.indriyayamaka.1 ff.) – the eye faculty, ear faculty, nose faculty, tongue faculty, body faculty, mind faculty, femininity faculty, masculinity faculty, life faculty, pleasure faculty, pain faculty, joy faculty, displeasure faculty, equanimity faculty, faith faculty, energy faculty, mindfulness faculty, concentration faculty, wisdom faculty, the faculty of 'I shall know the unknown,' the faculty of final knowledge, the faculty of one who has final knowledge.

Padasodhanavāro

The Section on Term Analysis.

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order.

Cakkhu [V 0.0084] cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhu.

The eye is the eye faculty; the eye faculty is the eye.

Sotaṃ sotindriyaṃ, sotindriyaṃ sotaṃ.

The ear is the ear faculty; the ear faculty is the ear.

Ghānaṃ ghānindriyaṃ, ghānindriyaṃ ghānaṃ.

The nose is the nose faculty; the nose faculty is the nose.

Jivhā jivhindriyaṃ, jivhindriyaṃ jivhā.

The tongue is the tongue faculty; the tongue faculty is the tongue.

Kāyo kāyindriyaṃ, kāyindriyaṃ kāyo.

The body is the body faculty; the body faculty is the body.

Mano manindriyaṃ, manindriyaṃ mano.

The mind is the mind faculty; the mind faculty is the mind.

Itthī itthindriyaṃ, itthindriyaṃ itthī.

The female is the femininity faculty; the femininity faculty is the female.

Puriso purisindriyaṃ, purisindriyaṃ puriso.

The male is the masculinity faculty; the masculinity faculty is the male.

Jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, jīvitindriyaṃ jīvitaṃ.

Life is the life faculty; the life faculty is life.

Sukhaṃ sukhindriyaṃ, sukhindriyaṃ sukhaṃ.

Pleasure is the pleasure faculty; the pleasure faculty is pleasure.

Dukkhaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ, dukkhindriyaṃ dukkhaṃ.

Pain is the pain faculty; the pain faculty is pain.

Somanassaṃ somanassindriyaṃ, somanassindriyaṃ somanassaṃ.

Mental joy is the faculty of mental joy; the faculty of mental joy is mental joy.

Domanassaṃ domanassindriyaṃ, domanassindriyaṃ domanassaṃ.

Mental pain is the faculty of mental pain; the faculty of mental pain is mental pain.

Upekkhā upekkhindriyaṃ, upekkhindriyaṃ upekkhā.

Equanimity is the equanimity faculty; the equanimity faculty is equanimity.

Saddhā saddhindriyaṃ, saddhindriyaṃ saddhā.

Faith is the faith faculty; the faith faculty is faith.

Vīriyaṃ vīriyindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ vīriyaṃ.

Energy is the energy faculty; the energy faculty is energy.

Sati [M 0.0082] satindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ sati.

Mindfulness is the mindfulness faculty; the mindfulness faculty is mindfulness.

Samādhi samādhindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ samādhi.

Concentration is the concentration faculty; the concentration faculty is concentration.

Paññā paññindriyaṃ, paññindriyaṃ paññā.

Wisdom is the wisdom faculty; the wisdom faculty is wisdom.

Anaññātaññassāmīti anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ, anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ anaññātaññassāmīti.

The thought, 'I shall know the unknown,' is the faculty of 'I shall know the unknown'; the faculty of 'I shall know the unknown' is the thought, 'I shall know the unknown.'

Aññaṃ aññindriyaṃ, aññindriyaṃ aññaṃ.

Final knowledge is the final knowledge faculty; the final knowledge faculty is final knowledge.

Aññātāvī aññātāvindriyaṃ, aññātāvindriyaṃ aññātāvī.

One who has final knowledge is the faculty of one who has final knowledge; the faculty of one who has final knowledge is one who has final knowledge.

Paccanīkaṃ

Antithetical

Na [V 0.0085] cakkhu na cakkhundriyaṃ, na cakkhundriyaṃ na cakkhu.

Not the eye, not the eye faculty; not the eye faculty, not the eye.

Na sotaṃ na sotindriyaṃ, na sotindriyaṃ na sotaṃ.

Not the ear, not the ear faculty; not the ear faculty, not the ear.

Na ghānaṃ na ghānindriyaṃ, na ghānindriyaṃ na ghānaṃ.

Not the nose, not the nose faculty; not the nose faculty, not the nose.

Na jivhā na jivhindriyaṃ, na jivhindriyaṃ na jivhā.

Not the tongue, not the tongue faculty; not the tongue faculty, not the tongue.

Na kāyo na kāyindriyaṃ, na kāyindriyaṃ na kāyo.

Not the body, not the body faculty; not the body faculty, not the body.

Na mano na manindriyaṃ, na manindriyaṃ na mano.

Not the mind, not the mind faculty; not the mind faculty, not the mind.

Na itthī na itthindriyaṃ, na itthindriyaṃ na itthī.

Not the female, not the female faculty; not the female faculty, not the female.

Na puriso na purisindriyaṃ, na purisindriyaṃ na puriso.

Not the male, not the male faculty; not the male faculty, not the male.

Na jīvitaṃ na jīvitindriyaṃ, na jīvitindriyaṃ na jīvitaṃ.

Not life, not the life faculty; not the life faculty, not life.

Na sukhaṃ na sukhindriyaṃ, na sukhindriyaṃ na sukhaṃ.

Not pleasure, not the pleasure faculty; not the pleasure faculty, not pleasure.

Na dukkhaṃ na dukkhindriyaṃ, na dukkhindriyaṃ na dukkhaṃ.

Not pain, not the pain faculty; not the pain faculty, not pain.

Na somanassaṃ na somanassindriyaṃ, na somanassindriyaṃ na somanassaṃ.

Not mental joy, not the faculty of mental joy; not the faculty of mental joy, not mental joy.

Na domanassaṃ na domanassindriyaṃ, na domanassindriyaṃ na domanassaṃ.

Not mental pain, not the faculty of mental pain; not the faculty of mental pain, not mental pain.

Na upekkhā na upekkhindriyaṃ, na upekkhindriyaṃ na upekkhā.

Not equanimity, not the equanimity faculty; not the equanimity faculty, not equanimity.

Na saddhā na saddhindriyaṃ, na saddhindriyaṃ na saddhā.

Not faith, not the faith faculty; not the faith faculty, not faith.

Na vīriyaṃ na vīriyindriyaṃ, na vīriyindriyaṃ na vīriyaṃ.

Not energy, not the energy faculty; not the energy faculty, not energy.

Na sati na satindriyaṃ, na satindriyaṃ na sati.

Not mindfulness, not the mindfulness faculty; not the mindfulness faculty, not mindfulness.

Na samādhi na samādhindriyaṃ, na samādhindriyaṃ na samādhi.

Not concentration, not the concentration faculty; not the concentration faculty, not concentration.

Na [M 0.0083] paññā na paññindriyaṃ, na paññindriyaṃ na paññā.

Not wisdom, not the wisdom faculty; not the wisdom faculty, not wisdom.

Na anaññātaññassāmīti na anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ, na anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ na anaññātaññassāmīti.

Not ‘I shall know the unknown,’ not the faculty of ‘I shall know the unknown’; not the faculty of ‘I shall know the unknown,’ not ‘I shall know the unknown.’

Na aññaṃ na aññindriyaṃ, na aññindriyaṃ na aññaṃ.

Not final knowledge, not the final knowledge faculty; not the final knowledge faculty, not final knowledge.

Na aññātāvī na aññātāvindriyaṃ, na aññātāvindriyaṃ na aññātāvī.

Not one who has final knowledge, not the faculty of one who has final knowledge; not the faculty of one who has final knowledge, not one who has final knowledge.

Padasodhanamūlacakkavāro

The Root Wheel on the Analysis of Terms

Anulomaṃ

Forward Order

Cakkhu [V 0.0086] cakkhundriyaṃ, indriyā sotindriyaṃ.

The eye is the eye faculty; the ear faculty is a faculty.

Cakkhu cakkhundriyaṃ, indriyā ghānindriyaṃ.

The eye is the eye faculty; the nose faculty is a faculty.

Cakkhu cakkhundriyaṃ, indriyā jivhindriyaṃ.

The eye is the eye faculty; the tongue faculty is a faculty.

Cakkhu cakkhundriyaṃ, indriyā kāyindriyaṃ.

Nigamanaṃ

Conclusion

Sattappakaraṇanāmato[M 0.0095][V 0.0098], abhidhammamadesayi;

Devātidevo devānaṃ, devalokamhi taṃ pure.

The god of gods, teacher of gods, formerly in the world of the gods, expounded the Abhidhamma named the Seven Treatises.

Tassāyaṃ mātikā sabbā, sakalassāpi uddharā;

Ciraṭṭhitatthaṃ dhammassa, taṃ paggaṇhantu sādhavo.

This entire matrix is extracted from the whole; may the virtuous uphold it for the long-lastingness of the Dhamma.

Dvāvīsati tikā ceva, tatheva hetugocchakaṃ;

Cūḷantaradukā satta, gocchakā ca tato paraṃ.

Twenty-two triplets, and likewise the root-cluster; seven minor intermediate dyads, and then the clusters thereafter.

Mahantaradukā cāpi, tato cuddasa niddise;

Gocchakāni duve piṭṭhi-dukāniṭṭhārasedisā.

And also the major intermediate dyads, then fourteen should be specified; two clusters, the back-dyads, and those similar to the eighteen.

Dvācattālīsa suttanta-dukā tevanti pañcadhā;

Sattappakaraṇikā bhinnā, dhammasaṅgaṇimātikā.

Forty-two discourse dyads; thus they are fivefold. The matrix of the Dhammasaṅgaṇī is divided into the seven treatises.

Abhidhammamātikāpāḷi niṭṭhitā.

The Pāli Text of the Abhidhamma Matrix is concluded.

Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa

Homage to the Blessed One, the Arahant, the Perfectly Self-Enlightened One.

Mohavicchedanī

The Dispeller of Delusion

Ganthārambhakathā

Introduction to the Text

1. Kāruññabhāvitaṃ [M 0.0001][V 0.0001] yassa, ñāṇacakkhu mahodayaṃ.

Andhabhūtassa lokassa, jātaṃ sāmaññalocanaṃ.

1. He whose great eye of wisdom, developed by compassion, has become the universal eye for a world that has become blind.

2. Taṃ buddhaṃ sugataṃ dhīraṃ, sasaddhammaṃ sasāvakaṃ.

Vanditvānussaritvā ca, thometvā ca vināyakaṃ.

2. Having paid homage to, recollected, and praised that Buddha—the Well-Gone One, the wise, the Guide—together with the true Dhamma and his disciples.

3. There ca thirasīlādi-guṇālaṅkārasobhite.

Sāsanujjotake dhīre, pubbake vaṃsapālake.

3. And the elders, adorned with the ornaments of virtues such as steadfast morality, the wise illuminators of the Dispensation, the former guardians of the lineage.

4. Visuddhidevadevo [V 0.0002] yaṃ, devānaṃ tidasālaye.

Paññāya desayī tassa, abhidhammassa mātikā.

4. The god of gods by purity, in the Tāvatiṃsa heaven, expounded with wisdom to the gods the matrix of that Abhidhamma.

5. Yā tassā vipulatthāya, dhammasaṅgaṇiādihi.

Anekehi pakārehi, pāḷiaṭṭhakathāhi ca.

5. For the extensive meaning of which, the explanation is given by means of the Dhammasaṅgaṇī and so on, in many ways, and by the Pāli texts and commentaries.

6. Attho vinicchayo ceva,

Vibhatto sāgarūpamo;

Anantanayavokiṇṇo,

Dukkhogāho yato tato.

6. Its meaning and ascertainment, indeed, are explained like the ocean, permeated by endless methods, difficult to fathom from any quarter.

7. Samāsenābhidhammatthaṃ, mātikāmukhatokhilaṃ.

Ñātukāmehi suddhehi, antevāsīhi yācito.

7. I was requested by pure disciples who desire to know the essence of the Abhidhamma in brief, the whole classified under the matrices, without omission.

8. Saṅkaḍḍhitvāna [M 0.0002] nayato, pāḷiaṭṭhakathāgataṃ.

Atthaṃ vinicchayañceva, samāsena nirākulaṃ.

8. Having systematically extracted the meaning and ascertainment from the Pāli and the commentaries, concisely and without confusion.

9. Sāmatthiyagataṃ atthaṃ, nikāyantaranissaṭaṃ.

Mahāvihāravāsīnaṃ, kamābhatanayānugaṃ.

9. The meaning that has reached its full capacity, free from sectarian deviations, following the progressive method of the Mahāvihāra residents.

10. Dīpayanto nayaññūnaṃ, sadā sammodakāriniṃ.

Mohavicchedaniṃ nāma, karissāmatthavaṇṇananti.

10. Illuminating for those who know the method, always bringing joy, we shall compose a commentary called 'The Dispeller of Delusion'.

Ganthārambhakathā niṭṭhitā.

The introductory discourse is concluded.

1. Dhammasaṅgaṇīmātikā

1. The Matrix of the Dhammasaṅgaṇī

Tikapadatthavaṇṇanā

Exposition of the Meanings of the Triadic Terms
